coverage: File-level inventory across selected operation roots; curated semantic synthesis of pinned sources. Inventory-only entries are not claimed to be semantically reviewed.
limitations: External active sources are frozen snapshots; later changes require curated successor ingestion.
Historical verification is scoped to exact recorded bytes and fixtures.
No full automatic printed/handwritten classifier, generalized geometry solver or canonical rubric is installed by this release.
Native retrieval trials measure actual time/tokens; causal knowledge-space savings remain unmeasured. Packet size is a retrieval bound.
